name: manageBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: MANAGEINBOXES id-list (Scn_FindIdList). Tested against g_camPos (the camera eye, not the Wolf) every frame. | count (+4): element count written by Scn_FindIdList

name: entries
meaning: managed objects from OBJECT01..OBJECT20 id-lists; appended without a bounds check

name: camZoneState
meaning: 0 before the first update, 1 camera outside every box, 2 inside one (ObjMgrCamZone)

name: keepUpdating
meaning: ACTION & 1. 0: outside the boxes objects are hidden (4) AND frozen (0x2000), and their 0x6000 bits are restored on entry. 1: hide only, but the mask bug wipes all flags.
